tara: Heads-up: onboarding comet-64k (int4v2) into long-fuzz. Hitting a reproducible rotary-phase jitter that manifests as a one-token KV index slip around 33k tokens. Also a modest latency spike.
oz: share repro command and minimal log?
tara: repro:
```
./ci/onboard_long.sh --model comet-64k --quant int4v2 --seq 34000 --batch 1 --seed 21
```
log excerpt:
```
[kv] shard=1 write_pos=33012 expected_idx=33012 got_idx=33013
[rot] accum=33012.997 -> recompute=33013.000 delta=0.003
[token] out: "on" -> later "\n" at pos 33019
[perf] tok_latency: 150ms -> 185ms
```
mohit: fp16/int8 clean?
tara: fp16 clean to full run. int8 clean. int4 path only.
oz: sounds like rounding in rotary accumulation + quant LUT interpolation. Try turning on ROTARY_RENORM=1000 and DEBUG_ROPE_CHECK=1 to gather cheap checksums.
tara: did that. RENORM delayed the event to ~55k when enabled, and the checksum flag shows a small but growing delta starting ~32.8k.
ci-bot: Incident created: IN-302468-ROT-JITTER. Linked run 3024681357.
ops-bot: snapshot saved s3://redwood-ci/comet/3024681357/snap.tar.gz (tags:int4v2,rot-jitter)
mohit: quick mitigation idea: on long sequences (>16k) compute rotary phase accumulators in fp32 while keeping activation quantized (mixed-precision rotary). Should eliminate drift at small perf cost.
oz: another weak point is packed phase serialization during periodic compaction. If async compaction interleaves with phase writes, a small rounding difference could flip an index. Try KV_EVICT_SYNC=1 and KV_PREFETCH=0.
tara: ran sync-evict experiment: jitter moved but still reproducible later. Mixed-precision rotary (local patch) removed repro in 3/3 runs to 100k but with ~7% throughput cost.
mohit: plan: 1) add cheap runtime guard (ROTARY_GUARD) that computes 8-lane checksum every 512 tokens and flips to mixed-precision only when delta>threshold; 2) add nonfatal assertion in kvcache writer to record (shard,pos,checksum) on mismatch; 3) bench matrix for quant kernels + eviction modes.
oz: owners: mohIt (guard + PR), tara (matrix runs + logs), oz (audit packed serialization). I'll also open a telemetry event for sampled guard triggers.
tara: thanks. I'll kick off overnight matrix and attach results. :thumbsup:
